description: The *ACL style acl.sty (commit 2427282, 2025-08-19; no version line), on plain article, used by ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, EACL, AACL and Findings. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from github.com/acl-org/acl-style-files. 11pt as the official template sets it. With no option the style is in final mode (its default): authors shown, no line numbers, no page numbers. Two columns on A4: it calls \twocolumn and loads geometry with a4paper and margin=2.5cm, and it loads natbib, caption, xcolor and hyperref (unless nohyperref). Its only TFM font, \font\aclhv = phvb at 8pt, is for review-mode line numbers. The repository has a separate XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX template (acl_lualatex.tex) that sets TeX Gyre Termes X with babel; the font choice is left to the document.
